implementation.note: Actual baseline full-digital-SoC development configuration, exact 336 RAMSP1024X16 macros. Mapping/PVT/netlist equivalence are unreviewed; no timing, power, or contest pass claimed. No vendor simulation models are in the synthesis source list.

method: one independent averaged PT process per task; read_saif normalized measured activity
review_pending: Annotation file/default/propagated coverage, every SRAM pin including unknown dwell, and SRAM Liberty when/internal_power operating modes require review; no energy or score claim

inventory_declared_provenance.limit: Actual mapped names, pins, library cell identity only; no activity, Liberty or timing/power qualification

mapped_macro_bridge_receipt.limitation: This proves name relocation and measured-statistic preservation only. Original capture provenance, PT annotation, Liberty power and contest qualification remain separate reviews.
mapped_macro_bridge_receipt.policy: Exact complete 67-pin macro bijection; strict statistics and attribute sets; literal mapped dots; input immutable.

tasks.unknown_state_policy: TX/TZ/TB retained, including disabled DTCM; unknown state does not mean zero power
